capabilities: Copy selected lines as a Zed link via right-click or command
Copy files and folders as Zed links from the file explorer
Hand copied targets to the Zed CLI so they join the open project
Configure how the Zed CLI is invoked and where targets open
Explain why a copied link may fail to resolve in Zed
extras: Desktop only, since links must name real paths on disk. Developed and tested on Linux; macOS, Windows, and Flatpak Zed are supported but untested. Installable via BRAT with Santuzius/copy-as-zed-link.
problem: Getting Obsidian content into Zed's agent panel as usable context normally means pasting raw text or links that the agent does not resolve as attachments.

relations.evidence: Copy a passage, a note, or a folder as a link that Zed's agent panel embeds as context.

summary: Copies a selected passage, note, or folder as a Markdown link that Zed's agent panel embeds as a context attachment.
